text: Imagine telling investors you made a hundred million dollars, when you made a hundred thousand.
Theranos promised blood tests from one finger prick. Valuation: nine billion dollars.
Then reporters found the machine gave inaccurate results. Two years of results, voided.
Guilty on four counts. Eleven years.
Real question. Should the investors who never checked get their money back? Comment.
Follow. The next one is worse.
